thread:
Maya (support): hey team, Olga from AcmeCorp is getting a burst of 502/504s hitting the hosted API since ~09:10 UTC, customer is blocked :grimacing:
Olga (customer): yep, our prod traffic spikes around that time with large batch embeddings, we see frequent 502s and timeouts, trace id e4f9b2a7-8c
Maya (support): sending initial logs and a curl repro, can SRE triage?
Marco (cs): customer says errors started after yesterday's billing header rollout (we added X-Billing-Account) but not sure if related
Maya (support): repro curl below (sanitized):
```bash
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer ****" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -H "X-Billing-Account: tenant-4321" \\n  -d '{"model":"open-embed-xxl","inputs":[...lots of strings...]}'
```
Maya (support): using large payloads (60k tokens total) reproduces intermittent 502/504 with upstream reset in ~10-30s
infra-bot: incident created #INC-2026-0317-92, paging oncall
Jin (sre): looking at edge logs, seeing a pattern: Envoy upstream resets and connection window violations; many upstreams returning ECONNRESET when the request body is large
Jin (sre): sample envoy log snippet: `upstream_reset: reset reason=connection_failure, upstream_reset_reason=CONNECTION_TERMINATION, response_code=502, trace_id=e4f9b2a7`
Priya (infra): are these hitting a specific midproxy or frontdoor cluster?
Jin (sre): primarily frontdoor-usa-west and midproxy-batch, high inflight h2 streams and keepalive pool exhaustion observed around 09:08-09:12
Priya (infra): hmm, recent kube autoscaler reduced midproxy replicas during low traffic window last night — possible capacity mismatch when spike hit
Marco (cs): customer insists they didn't change request shape, only billing header added yesterday — could header exceed buffer or change routing?
Jin (sre): header alone shouldn't cause resets, but combined with large streaming body it increases frame sizes and h2 window pressure; also seeing increased retry loops to auth/billing service which adds extra fanout
Olga (customer): we do send per-item metadata in headers now, size per request up ~1.6KB additional
Maya (support): attached customer trace ids: e4f9b2a7-8c, d2c1a6f4-1b, f0b3c9e8-4a
Jin (sre): repro steps I ran: same curl, hit frontdoor with tcpdump shows many RSTs from midproxy pod when concurrent streams > 40; envoy stats: upstream_rq_pending_overflow spikes and upstream_cx_overflow
Priya (infra): config snapshot: envoy h2 max-concurrent-streams 100, per-worker conn pool 50, but our default GCE loadbalancer TCP window + pod limits may effectively reduce headroom
Jin (sre): temporary mitigation: 1) throttle client by rejecting oversized requests at edge (simple early 413) or 2) pin AcmeCorp to dedicated midproxy pool with tuned keepalive for a day
Marco (cs): customer wants a fast mitigation, can we pin them to a route?
Priya (infra): yes, we can add a tenant-specific route to dedicated-pool-2 manually; will take ~12-20 minutes to roll and test
Maya (support): I'll ask customer for permission to move traffic, Olga?
Olga (customer): please do the pin, we need stable throughput asap, will accept temporary rate-limiting on very large requests
Jin (sre): long-term root cause hypothesis: combined effect of (A) increased per-request header size (billing metadata), (B) larger request bodies (batch embeddings streaming), and (C) reduced midproxy capacity led to h2 flow-control exhaustion and upstream connection churn causing 502/504s
Priya (infra): action items:
- increase midproxy replica min to handle spikes (infra)
- raise envoy per-worker conn pool and tune keepalive (infra + eng)
- implement early request size rejection + user-facing guidance (product + support)
- add observability alert: upstream_cx_overflow > 0.5% over 5m (sre)
Maya (support): I've got customer consent, proceeding with pin to dedicated-pool-2 and temporary 413 policy for requests > 200k bytes
infra-bot: runbook step executed: route pin applied to tenant-4321 -> dedicated-pool-2 by Priya at 09:24 UTC
Priya (infra): pinned and increasing replicas now, rolling pods into pool; monitoring metrics
Jin (sre): post-pin quick check: request success rate for tenant-4321 improved from 72% -> 98% over 5m, no upstream resets observed so far
Marco (cs): I'll update customer and mark as mitigated pending infra changes
Olga (customer): confirmed errors dropped significantly, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
Maya (support): follow-ups: infra to create infra-PR for envoy tuning and autoscaler min increase; product to update doc about header limits and recommended payload chunking
Jin (sre): will run a stress test with header and body shapes to validate changes, saving traces to /opt/sre/traces/1855554321-repro
Maya (support): marking thread resolved for now, reopen if issues reappear
